surge.rationale: Shallow-water dam-break fronts advance ballistically at ~2*sqrt(g*h); sqrt(160/48)=1.83. Characterization screens allow dissipation and are deliberately loose: they are recorded per arm, are NOT admission criteria, and passing one is not owner feel acceptance. Admission criteria are the correctness invariants listed separately.
surge.inertial_lateral_sources: horizontal momentum arises only from diagonal moves (speed re-aimed along the move, turn loss booked) and blocked-fall deflection (f_deflect*vy to vx toward a free side, remainder booked); no pressure or column-height term; a static supported cell stays at zero velocity

target.law: isothermal: p_i * V_i = p_atm * V_i0 per sealed limb; equilibrium p_L + z_L = p_R + z_R (pressures in rows of Water head, z = surface height); equal limb widths, so z_L + z_R is constant
target.parameters: p_atm in rows is a declared pressure_flow_v1 family parameter in the receipt
